svg.title: Silent Ransom Group leaked-chat kill chain - callback and targeted vishing, remote tool, in-person agents, exfiltration and extortion
svg.desc: Two-lane kill chain. Left lane, the victim organisation: 1 target research on named people at large US law firms, 2 pretext infrastructure with look-alike domains and a 3CX PBX, 3 contact by callback email or a call to a named executive, 4 a remote session with a legitimate tool, 5 a physical fallback with an agent on site and a USB drive, 6 collection and exfiltration to Google Drive and rented SSH servers, 7 extortion through CHAT, OFFER, CONTRACT and GOLD. Stages 3 to 6 are critical. Right lane, the operator side: roles, retrospective infrastructure, agent plans, claimed money versus on-chain figures, the Sleepless Threat spin-off and the conflicts between KELA, GuidePoint and The Record. Detection anchors are the first-seen remote tool, the USB mount, look-alike sender domains and the published infrastructure.
svg.text: Silent Ransom Group leaked chats: vishing, remote tool, agents
Vendors: KELA, GuidePoint GRIT, The Record - Date: 2026-10-20 - Cluster: Silent Ransom Group (Luna Moth, UNC3753) - Day 119
VICTIM: LAW FIRM AND OTHER TARGETS (WINDOWS ENDPOINTS)
OPERATOR SIDE (LEAKED CHATS, UNVERIFIED)
Target research: named people at large US law firms
Partners, COOs, CIOs, GC; 13 cyber or privacy partners
Endpoint counts and security products noted per firm
GuidePoint GRIT
Pretext infrastructure: look-alike IT and law domains
-it.com, it-.com, -law.com patterns; mailboxes issued
Google Voice numbers and Gmail accounts per firm
3CX PBX on a rented VPS in the Netherlands
sokolovsky-law[.]com ominetdata[.]com
Contact: callback email or call to a named executive
MAIN: bulk email, PDF with a support number (degraded by June)
TRG/SPR: scheduled call, then hand-off to a specialist
No malware, no exploit, no link needed
Sigma n/a hunts H2 KQL k4
Remote session with a legitimate tool
AnyDesk, Zoho, Quick Assist (GuidePoint); Zoom, Teams (KELA)
FBI list adds Syncro, Atera, Splashtop
Operator takes control of the executive endpoint
Sigma 01-02, 07 KQL k1
Physical fallback: agent on site, USB, pretext
Agent poses as IT and uses a remote tool on the machine
USB drive discussed for delivering the tool
NY firm letter: files copied to a flash drive

Collection and exfiltration
Google Drive accounts (100 GB), SSH servers (600 GB each)
KELA lists Rclone and WinSCP; GuidePoint saw neither
Files read from shares and the endpoint, or copied to USB
Sigma 03-04, 06 KQL k3 Suricata 6360006
Extortion: CHAT, OFFER, CONTRACT, GOLD
Calls and voicemails to executives and assistants
Median 5.5x from first offer to payment, 10 days
Counsel and FBI contact, preserve evidence, no deletion trust
Claimed USD 206.95M, 27 of 50 orgs (unverified)
A

Adrian: principal and ledger; James: infrastructure lead

Agents: about 10 to 15 US helpers; 1 in 10 recruits usable
Telegram job ads, about USD 200 per advert

Bitcoin: 62 (KELA) or 65 (GuidePoint) addresses, unpublished
Sigma 05-06; YARA 2 rules

Agents and coercion plans (unverified)
Pretexts: delivery, cloned access card, cleaning contractor

Coercion and military-contact ideas: plans, no evidence
The Record could not verify the most extreme schemes

Ledger claim USD 206.95M across 27 organisations
Apr 13.55M, May 78.9M, Jun 25.5M, Jul none, Aug 21M, Sep 68M
Crystal Intelligence: wallets in chats got about 37 BTC
Gap between claim and chain is unexplained; all unverified
10 of USD 10M or more = USD 166.0M
C

Planned relaunch under a new brand from April 2026
Sleepless Rocket.Chat server from 2026-09-02
Brand domains discussed; registration not confirmed
Aliases: SRG, Luna Moth, Chatty Spider, UNC3753
sleepless[.]co sleeplessthreat[.]com
threatactorsneversleep[.]com
E
Source conflicts and caveats
Tools differ: KELA Rclone and WinSCP, GuidePoint neither
Authenticity unverified (KELA); GRIT moderate-to-high link
Leak date 10-06 / 10-07 / 10-08 depending on source
Indicators retrospective; sources read as page summaries
See README conflict table
no hashes, no sample, no CVE, no kev.md
Detection anchors: first-seen remote tool, USB mount, look-alike IT sender domains, published infrastructure
Rules in this folder: Sigma 01-07, KQL k1-k5, YARA srg_leak_infrastructure_strings.yar (2 rules), Suricata sids 6360001-6360010, PEAK hunts H1-H3.
No sample, no CVE, no hashes: the access is a call plus a legitimate tool. All figures are the operators claims or vendor readings, unverified.
Verify by callback to a directory number or a ticket before any install or code read-out; log USB, telephony and visitors.
